input.rationale: Section 13 meets the preferred position in full. Clause 13.1 grants the subscription access right to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf, with no revocability or transfer restriction. Clause 13.2 makes paid-up software and embedded Vendor Technology licences perpetual and irrevocable, including contractor support. Clause 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor under Section 24 and limits revocation or suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity. No licence-scope redline is required.
input.quote:
13.2 For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.</quote>
